title: YNX Finance — Read-only portfolio evidence and planning
metaDescription: Review source-bound YNX balances, activity, receipts and portfolio evidence without granting custody or execution authority.
features: Source, version, freshness and coverage states
risks: Finance does not provide banking, brokerage, custody or investment advice.
Exchange, DEX, Quant and Economics owner contracts are not centrally accepted.
The public Android Testnet Preview is test-signed, not production-signed or store-released.

faq.question: Can Finance move or trade assets?
faq.answer: No. Finance is read-only and cannot sign, trade, withdraw or hold assets.

faq.question: Does Finance show complete account history?
faq.answer: Not yet. Current activity is bounded to the latest indexed records and states that coverage explicitly.
